titles.native: ネコネコ ゴングショー

description:
A collaboration anime between Yousuke Kihara x studio dwarf.

NekoNeko Gong Show is a talent show where cats come out and show off their specialty.

The list of released videos included in this entry are as follows:
1) -爪とぎ名人の巻- (Scratching), Aug 14, 2015.
2) -腹話術名人の巻- (Ventriloquist), Aug 21, 2015.
3) -マジック名人の巻- (Magic), Sep 10, 2015.
4) -へび使い名人の巻- (Snake Charmer), Sep 10, 2015.
5) -大砲ネコ名人の巻- (Cannonball Cat), Oct 08, 2015.
6) -黒ネコ名人の巻- (Black Cat Bad Luck), Nov 17, 2015.
